mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES rebounds from its sharp drop while TRANSIT stabilizes, commuter footfall will recover and lift RETAIL_REC within four weeks. The mechanism fails if workplace mobility stays depressed or transit remains weak despite the rebound.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell to -38.3 at t-1w then recovered to -12.7 at t-0w
fact:TRANSIT stayed negative across all four weeks
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES does not stay above its t-1w trough and RETAIL_REC does not exceed the last-4-week mean over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed shift toward grocery and pharmacy trips substitutes into neighborhood shopping trips and then spills over into retail visits, pushing RETAIL_REC up over the next two weeks. The claim fails if GROCERY_PHARM rises but RETAIL_REC does not improve within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above +10 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM remains elevated for two weeks but RETAIL_REC is flat or lower than its prior-4-week mean, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT drops more than 15 points below baseline, access friction and trip chaining weaken discretionary shopping, so RETAIL_REC turns down over the following month. The mechanism fails if a transit trough is not followed by weaker retail mobility within four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -18.1 at t-1w and -9.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT stays below -15 yet RETAIL_REC rises versus the last 28 days, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PARKS and RESIDENTIAL indicates holiday-style local time use rather than shopping-oriented movement, which suppresses retail-recreation mobility over the next week. The claim fails if outdoor and home-centered time rises but retail mobility also rises immediately.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS turned positive at t-1w and t-0w while RESIDENTIAL stayed positive
failure_condition: If PARKS and RESIDENTIAL remain elevated for one week and RETAIL_REC does not fall below its last-week level, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in residential stay-at-home time combined with weak workplace mobility signals winter substitution away from discretionary trips, producing lower RETAIL_REC over four weeks. The mechanism fails if home-centered behavior rises but retail visits do not soften.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed above baseline in all four weeks
fact:WORKPLACES remained negative in all four weeks
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline while WORKPLACES stays below baseline and RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior 4-week mean, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS swing from negative to positive, the same population shift toward leisure outings can crowd out indoor retail visits for two weeks. If park activity does not stay positive after the crossover, the retail drag should disappear.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses from negative to positive
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -5.0 at t-2w to 7.0 at t-1w and 6.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS remains positive after the crossover but RETAIL_REC does not decline versus the prior two-week average, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized slump in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates a restriction shock that reduces destination traffic, so RETAIL_REC should fall over the next month. The hypothesis fails if either commuting proxy recovers quickly without any subsequent retail decline.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are both below -10 in the same week
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are below -10 and RETAIL_REC is not lower than its last-4-week mean within 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If grocery/pharmacy mobility stays elevated while parks stay positive, short local errands and leisure replace shopping-center trips and keep RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next four weeks. The mechanism fails if both proxies remain high but retail mobility rises anyway.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS remain above baseline for four weeks and RETAIL_REC does not underperform the prior 4-week mean, the hypothesis is rejected.
